operator.name: Phi_fb
operator.pipeline_position: inserted between Z-computation and B_tau (Zeeman weights)
operator.formula: beta_Z_eff = max(beta_Z_min, beta_Z_base * (1.0 + gamma_fb_A * B_A - gamma_fb_D * B_D))
operator.note_B_D_normalization: Z_D = stalk[12:18] = 0 in all partition children (not partition-inherited). B_D normalized against Z_A (root mass-energy sector) to keep B_D in [0,1) at initialization and across full tree depth.
operator.equilibrium_condition: gamma_fb_A * B_A_star = gamma_fb_D * B_D_star => B_A_star = B_D_star when gamma_fb_A == gamma_fb_D
operator.p_yz_invariance: norm(S_A) and norm(Z_A) are both P_yz-invariant (norms); norm(S_D) P_yz-invariant (EXP-401 Fork B). => B_A, B_D P_yz-invariant => beta_Z_eff P_yz-invariant.

stability.linear_bound: gamma_fb_A * B_A - gamma_fb_D * B_D > -1.0 required for beta_Z_eff > 0 before clamp
stability.clamp_guarantee: beta_Z_eff >= beta_Z_min = 0.5 always; no collapse to zero
stability.linearized_stability_condition: gamma_fb_A in (0, 2.0) for beta_Z_base=2.0 (inherited from EXP-317 gate spec)
stability.ghost_10_prevention: B_D uses norm(Z_A) denominator; S_D_0=0 => B_D_0=0 at t=0; no t=1 collapse

ghost_axioms.ghost_10_risk: Z_D = Z[12:18] = 0 in all partition children. eps-only denominator gives B_D=norm(S_D)/eps at t>0. RESOLVED: B_D = norm(S_D)/(norm(Z_A)+eps).

assertions: [2]  beta_Z_eff(gamma_fb_A=0, gamma_fb_D=0) == beta_Z_base (reduce to EXP-401 with feedback disabled)
[3]  beta_Z_eff > beta_Z_min always (clamp active; no collapse)
[4]  beta_Z_eff increases when gamma_fb_A increases 0->0.5 (B_A amplification active)
[5]  beta_Z_eff decreases when gamma_fb_D increases 0->0.5 (B_D pullback active)
[6]  EXP-401 regression: 92 leaves at gamma_fb_A=0, gamma_fb_D=0
[7]  tau_opt distribution right-shifts at gamma_fb_A=0.5 vs gamma_fb_A=0 (larger Omega_AC under tighter Zeeman)
[8]  ||S_D|| responds to beta_Z_eff change (B_D couples back through G_inject_D modulation)
[9]  H_t hash chain continuous across Phi_fb operator insertion
[10] B_A in [0,2.0], B_D in [0,1.0) at seed depth (Ghost #10 prevention verified)
[3]  fwd_leaves == mir_leaves (tree structure P_yz-covariant under feedback)
[4]  Omega_AC_fwd == Omega_AC_mir (EXP-316 invariance holds under feedback)
[5]  S_D[3]_mir = -S_D[3]_fwd, S_D[4]_mir = -S_D[4]_fwd, S_D[5]_mir = S_D[5]_fwd (EXP-401 tensor covariance preserved under feedback)

exp403_gate.trigger: beta_Z_eff saturates at beta_Z_min in >50% of tree steps under default gamma_fb_D=0.5
exp403_gate.proposed_change: exponential: beta_Z_eff = beta_Z_base * exp(gamma_fb_A * B_A - gamma_fb_D * B_D)
exp403_gate.property: beta_Z_eff > 0 guaranteed without clamp; equilibrium B_A=B_D is exp(0)=1 fixed point

dual_arithmetic_invariant.primary_space: Z dynamics under L_tau/B_tau/R_tau; beta_Z_eff modulates B_tau only
dual_arithmetic_invariant.no_write_back: Phi_fb does not modify Z_t, stalk values, or S_A/S_D directly
